description: Semantic HTML with microdata layering on TopicAnswerCard + internal link graph anchor text diversity. Adds DefinedTerm itemscope/itemprop attributes and enhances ChapterTopicGraph with descriptive anchor text and rel attributes.
steps:
In apps/frontend/src/components/chapter/TopicAnswerCard.jsx, add Schema.org DefinedTerm microdata attributes to the existing markup: (a) Add `itemScope itemType='https://schema.org/DefinedTerm'` to the
element. (b) Add `itemProp='name'` to the

heading. (c) Add `itemProp='description'` to the definition

paragraph. (d) Add `itemProp='inDefinedTermSet'` with a hidden or element pointing to the chapter URL. This creates a triple-stack signal: JSON-LD (already present) + Microdata (new) + semantic HTML.

In apps/frontend/src/components/chapter/ChapterTopicGraph.jsx, enhance the GraphPill component: (a) For cross-chapter links (not anchors), change the displayed text from just `{title}` to `{title} in {subjectName}` format when a `subjectName` prop is available on the topic object. (b) Add `rel='related'` attribute on all cross-chapter <Link> elements. (c) Ensure the existing `data-topic-graph-link` attributes are preserved.

In ChapterTopicGraph.jsx, update the cross-chapter GraphPill rendering to pass along a `subjectName` field from the topic data (t.subject_name) as descriptive context. If t.subject_name is not available, fall back to showing just the title as before (backward compatible).
acceptance_criteria: TopicAnswerCard renders with itemscope='', itemType='https://schema.org/DefinedTerm' on the section element
TopicAnswerCard h2 has itemProp='name' and definition p has itemProp='description'
Cross-chapter links in ChapterTopicGraph have rel='related' attribute
Cross-chapter links display '{title} in {subject}' format when subject_name is available
Backward compatible - components render correctly when optional fields are missing
No visual regression - CSS classes unchanged, only semantic attributes added
verification: Run: cd apps/frontend && npx vitest run --reporter=verbose 2>&1 | tail -30
Verify the JSX output manually by reading the modified files and checking attributes are correctly placed
findings: All 62 passing test files continue to pass. 1 pre-existing test failure in AdminHealth.credits.test.jsx (5 tests) confirmed unrelated - fails on base branch as well.
